inputs.domain: environmental materials, processes, land and water systems
inputs.license: CC0 1.0 on native ENVO claims; imported ontology terms may have different licenses
inputs.caution: Terminology and class membership do not prove physical laws or interpret biblical imagery.
Useful for copper, sulfur, water, salts; avoid asserting ancient material identification from a vague gloss.

inputs.domain: body parts, eye, skin, blood, anatomy
inputs.license: CC BY 3.0 per OBO Foundry registry; imported dependencies separate
inputs.caution: Taxonomic anatomy terms do not prove physiological functions or symbolic claims.

inputs.release: pin native base variant when suitable
inputs.domain: qualities: brightness, size, color, heat, shape
inputs.license: CC BY 3.0 per OBO Foundry registry
inputs.caution: Vocabulary of qualities ONLY: PATO does not assert that a specific biblical lamp is bright or a plant red.
Keep uncertain ancient identification and time scope; do not override existing biblical place canon.

inputs.domain: Jewish commentary and reception link graph
inputs.license: Links CC BY; full text licenses independent
inputs.caution: Use link metadata only; commentary/reception is not independent proof of the biblical author's intent.

inputs.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL; verify individual field and derivative obligations
inputs.caution: Imported derivations can be incorrect, modern, unreviewed or incompatible with public-release obligations.
Many crowd-sourced assertions are weak and noisy; never convert into biblical facts.
Do not republish in BibleResearch immutable public asset bundle without rights clearance.

policy.import_scope: only evidence that fills a measured gap; no full knowledge graph mirror
policy.mapping: biblical sense to external concept stays candidate until independent validation
policy.unsupported_claims: reject or label; do not rank as direct biblical evidence
